name: ace
description: Code Engine ACE - Intelligent pattern learning with continuous auto-search. v6.6.0: Per-agent ACE tracking — every subagent now gets its own search→learn cycle (fixes cold LinUCB bandit). Previously subagent traces shipped playbook_used=[] (no reward signal) because the patterns-used state file had one writer (UserPromptSubmit = main-agent only); Task-spawned subagents never wrote a per-agent state file. New utils/patterns_used_state.py is the single source of truth; reader is per-agent-pure (terminal Stop reads -main, SubagentStop reads only its own -{agent_id}); PreToolUse writes per-agent domain history + search on first domain entry; SessionEnd GCs orphan state files. Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.139, ace-cli >= 3.17.0 (@ace-sdk/core >= 2.19.0).
